text: Connected BAM share fell 0.02 percentage points over 22 hours, though it is up 0.19 percentage points over 7 days at 34.4%. Leadership remains whale-driven: the top node changed hands 70 times this window, with ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee now largest at 21.7% of BAM stake. Concentration is elevated but bounded by the current map: the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3 across 16 live BAM nodes.
